If x + 1/x = 3, what is x² + 1/x²?
questions.exp: Square both sides: x² + 2 + 1/x² = 9, so x² + 1/x² = 7.

questions.q: Which of the following sets of sides forms a right-angled triangle?
questions.exp: 8² + 15² = 64 + 225 = 289 = 17²; the other sets fail the Pythagoras relation.

questions.q: What is the mean proportional between 4 and 25?
questions.exp: Mean proportional = √(4 x 25) = 10.

questions.q: Which of the following is an open-ended question suitable for Class VI?
options: How many different rectangles with whole-number sides have an area of 24 square units?
questions.exp: An open-ended task has several valid answers/approaches and encourages exploration; the others have a single fixed answer.

questions.q: At sunset, Rohan's shadow falls to his left. Towards which direction is Rohan facing?
questions.exp: At sunset the sun is in the west, so the shadow falls towards the east. If the east is on his left, he must be facing south.

questions.q: If ÷ means +, × means ÷, − means × and + means −, then the value of 18 ÷ 6 × 3 − 5 + 2 is:
Find the next letter: Z, X, U, Q, L, ?
questions.exp: The positions are 26, 24, 21, 17, 12; the differences are −2, −3, −4, −5, so the next is 12 − 6 = 6, which is F.

questions.q: If all A are B, all B are C and no C is D, which of the following is definitely true?
questions.exp: A ⊂ B ⊂ C and C has no overlap with D, so A, being inside C, cannot overlap with D.

questions.q: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 3:15?
questions.exp: At 3:15 the hour hand is at 90 + 7.5 = 97.5° and the minute hand is at 90°. The angle is 7.5°.
